stories.title: Man dies in early morning house fire near Garland District
stories.summary: A man died in a house fire that was reported around 4:30 a.m. Monday. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

stories.title: Coeur d'Alene Lighting Ceremony Parade returns Friday for its 34th year
stories.summary: This year's parade theme, Santa's Workshop, will transform Sherman Ave. into a festive celebration filled with twinkling lights, creative floats and holiday cheer.

stories.title: Spokane Colleges' campus food pantries get funding boost from MultiCare
stories.summary: MultiCare Health System’s Community Partnership Fund awarded $45,000 over the next three years to Spokane Colleges Foundation to support the food distribution.

stories.title: Nearly 1 million acres burned: Washington's DNR commissioner reviews state's worst wildfire season yet
stories.summary: Washington DNR Commissioner says the state just endured its most destructive wildfire season on record, urges lawmakers not to cut prevention funding.

stories.title: Stevens County Sheriff's Office searching for suspect who shot at law enforcement
stories.summary: Officials are searching for a suspect armed with a rifle who may have escaped the area in a stolen white 2018 Polaris Ranger. Call 911 if seen.

stories.title: Nippon Dynawave victims’ families pursue justice as investigation reveals 75 workplace safety violations
stories.summary: Some families of Nippon Dynawave victims are seeking justice after state investigators uncovered dozens of safety violations and issued millions in fines.

stories.title: ICE used 'very poor tactics' in airport arrest, law enforcement analyst says
stories.summary: After reviewing video of ICE officers arresting two people on a jet bridge, former King County Sheriff and law enforcement analyst John Urquhart was critical.

stories.title: The first snowfall of the season is here!
stories.summary: KREM 2's Snow Tracker is on the road covering the first snowfall of the season.

stories.title: 'They're traumatized': Attorney for family detained at SEA denies ICE claims of assault
stories.summary: ICE said it will charge Sofia Larrondo Hernandez Mejia with assault on a federal officer, claiming she threw hot coffee on officers detaining her father.

stories.title: ICE 'out of control' in dramatic SEA arrest caught on camera, governor says
stories.summary: Dramatic video showed masked ICE officers detaining two passengers on a jet bridge at SEA Airport Saturday morning.

stories.title: Sandpoint residents to receive free parking permits next year
stories.summary: The Sandpoint City Council voted unanimously to approve the parking permit changes at its Nov. 18 meeting.

stories.title: Rathdrum development offers ownership opportunities for individuals making 80% of area median income
stories.summary: The Hayden Homes Solara community is slated to be complete and ready for move-in by fall 2027, a press release said.
